question: Y can complete a work in 20 days and Z can complete the same work in 10 days. If both of them work together, then in 2 days what percent work of the total work will be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

Y can complete a work in 20 days.

Z can complete the same work in 10 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work completed by Y in 1 day = 1/20

Work completed by Z in 1 day = 1/10

Work completed by Y and Z together in 1 day = (1/20) + (1/10)
